verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a LibreChat docs page titled "Scheduled Chats", which shows the product has its own first-party scheduling feature. The pack gives only the page title, so it doesn't show whether schedules recur or are one-off, or whether workflows (as opposed to chats) can be scheduled. missing for 10: evidence of recurring schedule support (cron/interval), scheduling of agent workflows beyond chats, feature details or configuration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
